groups.G2: 原生对象与地图（组级硬门槛：B01 失败则本组记 0）/ Native objects & maps (group gate: B01)
groups.G4: 跨报告隐藏考点 / Cross-report hidden points
groups.G5: 反事实边界推理 / Counterfactual-boundary reasoning

task_level: 交付物缺失或无法打开 / deliverables missing or unopenable
作弊/违规 / cheating or rule violation (network, hidden files)

scoring: continuous score = sum(weight of passed items) after group gates; Perfect = all items pass

items.criterion_zh: presentation.pptx 存在，且通过包完整性检查（zip 完整、内容类型、关系目标存在、XML 良构、python-pptx 可打开、无外链），作为 Windows 桌面版 PowerPoint 16.0 无修复提示打开的代理；失败则 G2 整组记 0。
items.criterion_en: presentation.pptx exists and passes the package-integrity check (zip intact, content types, relationships resolve, well-formed XML, python-pptx opens, no external links) as the proxy for opening in Windows desktop PowerPoint 16.0 without a repair prompt; failure zeroes group G2.
items.verify: checks.py b01(): dlib.pptx_integrity() + external-link scan (structural proxy; no PowerPoint on the Linux grader).

items.criterion_en: Exactly 12 slides, 16:9.
items.verify: python-pptx: len(slides)==12 and slide_width/slide_height within 1% of 16/9.

items.criterion_zh: slides.pdf 为 12 页，顺序与标题与 PPTX 一致。
items.criterion_en: slides.pdf has 12 pages whose order and titles match the PPTX.
items.verify: pdfinfo pages==12; pdftotext first line of each page vs pptx title placeholder text (fuzzy ≥0.8).

items.criterion_zh: script.md 逐页给出逐字稿与时长，合计 12–15 分钟，标注点击事件；PPTX 演讲者备注与讲稿逐页一致（≥11/12 页词重合 ≥80%）。
items.criterion_en: script.md gives per-slide verbatim text and durations summing to 12–15 min with click events marked; PPTX speaker notes match the script (≥11/12 slides with ≥80% token overlap).
items.verify: Parse script.md durations; python-pptx notes_slide text vs script per slide (token Jaccard).

items.criterion_zh: evidence-index.csv 含规定 8 列，且每个承载事实的页面至少有一行。
items.criterion_en: evidence-index.csv has the 8 required columns and at least one row for every fact-bearing slide.
items.verify: checks.py: header has the 8 columns; every fact-bearing slide (a digit in slide text or notes, or a chart/table/picture) is covered by >=1 row.

items.criterion_zh: calculations.xlsx 中每个推导量都有实时公式（非粘贴值）以及源值、单位、报告与页码。
items.criterion_en: calculations.xlsx gives every derived quantity a live formula (not a pasted value) plus source values, units, report and page.
items.verify: openpyxl (data_only=False): result cells start with '='; required columns non-empty. Cross-check that intervals shown on slides appear here.

items.criterion_zh: playback-check.md 写明软件与版本、实际验证项（含具体结果）与未验证项；除非写明版本并给出具体观察结果，否则不声称在 Windows PowerPoint 中测试过。
items.criterion_en: playback-check.md states software and version, what was verified (with concrete results) and what was not; it claims no test in Windows PowerPoint unless it names the version and gives concrete observed results.
items.verify: Judge reads playback-check.md. Self-reports are not evidence for other items.

items.criterion_zh: 标明 AI 制作，源报告单独署名，未暗示发布机构审阅或背书。
items.criterion_en: AI production disclosed, source reports credited separately, no implied review/endorsement by the authoring agencies.
items.verify: Text scan of slides+notes for disclosure/credit; reviewer reads for endorsement implication.

items.criterion_zh: 正文 ≥20 pt、图注/出处 ≥12 pt、每页 ≤6 条要点。
items.criterion_en: Body text ≥20 pt, captions/source lines ≥12 pt, ≤6 bullets per slide.
items.verify: checks.py: run sizes resolved through run/paragraph/shape lstStyle/layout+master placeholder/txStyles/defaultTextStyle with normAutofit fontScale; body = body/object placeholders or the slide's main text box (>=20 words, not a source/caption line) must be >=20 pt; all other text >=12 pt; bullet paragraphs summed over all non-title text frames of a slide <=6.

items.criterion_zh: 六节按规定顺序出现，无空分隔页。
items.criterion_en: Six sections appear in the required order; no empty divider slides.
items.verify: Reviewer maps each slide to a section; any slide without evidence content fails.

items.criterion_zh: 两份报告均被实质使用：evidence-index 中两份报告各 ≥5 行。
items.criterion_en: Both reports used substantively: ≥5 evidence-index rows citing each report.
items.verify: Count rows by report column (TN 2252 / TN 2135 or equivalent naming).

items.criterion_zh: ≥3 个原生图表，每个在 PowerPoint 中“编辑数据”可打开嵌入工作簿。
items.criterion_en: ≥3 native charts; Edit Data opens the embedded workbook for each in PowerPoint.
items.verify: pptx zip: ppt/charts/chart*.xml with c:externalData -> ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx; PowerPoint: right-click > Edit Data on each.

items.criterion_zh: 图表嵌入工作簿列出源值、单位、报告与页码，推导值用公式。
items.criterion_en: Chart workbooks list source values, units, report and page, and use formulas for derived values.
items.verify: checks.py fails workbooks without page/report labels; judge reads the embedded workbook cell values and formulas (structure.embedded_workbook_summary) for units and formula use.

items.criterion_zh: 分区“通知—火到达间隔”图：数据与 TN 2252 表 11（p.56/PDF 94）一致——抽查 ≥8 个分区，分钟精确；页面写明时间基准（IC 请求或 CodeRED）与正负号约定。
items.criterion_en: Zone-by-zone notification-vs-fire-arrival chart matches TN 2252 Table 11 (p.56 / PDF 94) for ≥8 spot-checked zones to the minute; slide states time basis (IC request or CodeRED) and sign convention.
items.verify: checks.py m03(): chart whose categories (or series) are Table 11 zones; every plotted value of a key zone must equal first-fire minus/plus a request/CodeRED time, or one of those clock times, within 1 min (minutes, hours or Excel day fractions); >=8 zones; slide text/chart/axis titles must name the time basis (request/CodeRED) and a sign convention.

items.criterion_zh: 呈现的 11 月 8 日早晨 burnover 编号、地点、时刻与 TN 2252 表 30（p.125/PDF 163）一致，无一错误。
items.criterion_en: Every Nov-8-morning burnover shown has ID, location and time matching TN 2252 Table 30 (p.125 / PDF 163); no errors.
items.verify: Judge compares slide text (incl. grouped shapes and table cells) and notes with the answer-key burnovers list.

items.criterion_zh: ≥3 幅图片裁切各与报告某页匹配（与 evidence-index.csv 中该页所引 PDF 页（±1）或已知地图页做图像模板匹配），两份报告各 ≥1 幅；均非整页截图；每幅匹配的裁切上至少放有一个原生可编辑形状（解释未烧录进图片）。
items.criterion_en: ≥3 picture crops each match a page of a report (image template match against the PDF page cited in evidence-index.csv for that slide, ±1, or a known map page), with ≥1 from each report; none is a full-page image; each matched crop has at least one native editable shape placed on it (explanations not baked into the image).
items.verify: checks.py m05(): pdftoppm 40 dpi grey page renders, OpenCV multi-scale normalised cross-correlation >=0.6; matched area <85% of the page; >=1 non-picture shape intersecting the picture bbox. Legend/scale retention and legibility are not scored (not measurable from the evidence).

items.criterion_zh: 某地图页用 ≥4 个可分别编辑的原生点击进入动画，每步显示的标签可识别一处 11 月 8 日上午的 burnover（表 30 编号“#N”或道路名），且各步按时间先后排列（标签有时刻则按标签，否则按表 30 时刻）。
items.criterion_en: On a map slide, ≥4 separately editable native on-click entrance animations each reveal a label identifying a Nov-8-morning burnover (Table 30 '#N' or its road) and the steps are in chronological order (label time if given, else Table 30 time).
items.verify: checks.py m06(): p:timing main-sequence clickEffect/entr on distinct shapes of a slide with a picture; revealed text mapped to answer-key Table 30 rows with time <=12:00 Nov 8; non-decreasing order.

items.criterion_zh: 原生形状绘制的可编辑边界示意图，对 (a)(b)(c) 三种做法都区分观测记录/推断/不被支持的说法。
items.criterion_en: Editable native-shape boundary diagram separating observed record / inference / unsupported for all three alternatives (a)(b)(c).
items.verify: pptx: diagram composed of p:sp shapes (not a picture); reviewer checks three alternatives × three categories.

items.criterion_zh: 所用总体数字正确：约 40 000 人疏散、85 人死亡、>18 000 栋建筑损毁、31 个 TRA/>1200 平民、198 起 EA/R/≥1000 平民（TN 2252 摘要 p.iii）。任何一处错误即否。
items.criterion_en: Headline figures used are correct: 40 000 evacuated, 85 fatalities, >18 000 structures destroyed, 31 TRAs / >1200 civilians, 198 EA/R events / ≥1000 civilians (TN 2252 abstract p.iii). Any error fails.
items.verify: Text scan of slides/notes against answer-key headline values.

items.criterion_zh: 逐页忠实：任何一页（含备注）都没有与 answer-key 相矛盾、或未列入 evidence-index.csv 的数字、时刻、计数或归属。
items.criterion_en: Per-slide fidelity: no slide or note gives a number, time, count or attribution that contradicts the answer key or is absent from evidence-index.csv.
items.verify: Judge compares slides/notes with the answer key and evidence-index.csv.

items.criterion_zh: evidence-index 页码准确：以固定种子抽 10 行，≥9 行的 PDF 页与印刷页一致（TN 2252：PDF = 印刷 + 38，罗马页 + 2；TN 2135：PDF = 印刷 + 30），且该 PDF 页上能找到该行论断中的数字（≥3 字符）或 ≥60% 的实义词。
items.criterion_en: evidence-index page accuracy: of 10 rows sampled with a fixed seed, ≥9 give a PDF page consistent with the printed page (TN 2252: PDF = printed + 38, roman + 2; TN 2135: PDF = printed + 30) and that PDF page contains the claim's number (≥3 characters) or ≥60% of its content words.
items.verify: checks.py m10(): pdftotext of the cited PDF page of input/main-report.pdf or input/companion-report.pdf.

items.criterion_zh: 区分 IC 请求时刻与 CodeRED 送达启动时刻，不混为一谈（如 Zones 3/8/14/Lower Pentz：疏散令请求 07:46，CodeRED 07:57）。
items.criterion_en: IC request times and CodeRED activation times are shown as distinct events, not conflated (e.g., Zones 3/8/14/Lower Pentz: order requested 07:46, CodeRED 07:57).
items.verify: Slides/notes/chart workbook; TN 2252 Table 11 and p.58.

items.criterion_zh: (b) 通行能力论证正确使用 OHU/疏散车道比（表 4 p.28：Paradise 927、Magalia 1264、Concow 164 等所用值），并说明该比值不是显式通行能力指标。
items.criterion_en: Alternative (b) uses OHU/egress-lane ratios correctly (Table 4 p.28: e.g., Paradise 927, Magalia 1264, Concow 164 as used) and states the ratio is not an explicit capacity measure.
items.verify: Compare values used; look for the caveat (TN 2252 p.28).

items.criterion_zh: 每页标题都是该页能支持的论断。
items.criterion_en: Every slide title is a claim the slide supports.
items.verify: Reviewer reads 12 titles against slide content.

items.criterion_zh: 全片一致的视觉编码区分观测/推断/不被支持（反事实）说法。
items.criterion_en: Consistent visual coding distinguishes observation / inference / unsupported (counterfactual) claims across the deck.
items.verify: Reviewer checks legend/style use on every slide carrying such claims.

items.criterion_zh: 所有形状位于页面内；渲染页中无文字溢出；点击序列显示的形状不遮挡其所标注的地图要素或其他常显文字。
items.criterion_en: All shapes lie inside the slide; no text overflows its box in the rendered pages; shapes revealed by the click sequence do not cover map features they annotate or other always-visible text.
items.verify: checks.py fails shapes beyond the slide bounds; judge checks overflow/occlusion on the rendered pages.

items.criterion_zh: 核心数值在页面、备注、图表工作簿、calculations.xlsx、讲稿、PDF 间一致（抽 6 个核心值）。
items.criterion_en: Core values agree across slides, notes, chart workbooks, calculations.xlsx, script and PDF (6 sampled core values).
items.verify: Judge checks 6 sampled core values in slide text, notes, chart_data and embedded workbook cell values, calculations.xlsx CSV, script and PDF text.

items.criterion_zh: 每条建议都对应到已呈现证据（标明页），且没有一条依赖不被支持的反事实。
items.criterion_en: Every recommendation points to evidence shown (slide reference) and none relies on an unsupported counterfactual.
items.verify: Reviewer reads recommendation slide(s) vs earlier slides.

items.criterion_zh: 不把技术访谈中的个人评论（如 TN 2135 附录 TD 引语）或非报告结论当作报告发现呈现；引用须标为受访者陈述。
items.criterion_en: Does not present technical-discussion interviewee comments (e.g., TN 2135 appendix TD quotes) or non-report opinions as report findings; such quotes are labelled as interviewee statements.
items.verify: Search slides/notes for quotes; check attribution (answer-key trap T01).

items.criterion_zh: burnover 总数跨报告对齐：TN 2135 记 19 起，TN 2252 记 23 起，#20–23 为 TN 2252 第二轮（救援数据分析）新增；两数及原因均呈现，不把 19 当总数。
items.criterion_en: Burnover total reconciled across reports: TN 2135 has 19, TN 2252 has 23, with #20–23 added in TN 2252's second round (rescue-data analysis); both numbers and the reason shown; 19 not presented as the total.
items.verify: answer-key H01 (TN 2252 p.7/PDF 45, p.123/PDF 161; TN 2135 p.117/PDF 147).

items.criterion_zh: 严重度分类按表计数：23 起 = 14 起 Category 1 + 9 起 Category 2（TN 2252 表 30）；不得沿用正文“seven Category 2”；未呈现分类计数也判否。
items.criterion_en: Severity split counted from the table: 23 = 14 Category 1 + 9 Category 2 (TN 2252 Table 30); repeating the text's 'seven Category 2' fails; not presenting the split fails.
items.verify: answer-key H02 (TN 2252 p.123 text vs Table 30; TN 2135 p.117 text '11+7' vs Table 33 11+8).

items.criterion_zh: 条件项：凡给出 11 月 8 日 10:00 前（或“上午”）burnover 计数，须为 11 起（9 Cat 1 + 2 Cat 2，表 30），或与正文“nine (7/2)”并列并指出差异；单独使用“nine”判否；未给出该计数不判否（若点击序列/页面所列上午 burnover 少于表 30 而又称完整，按 M04 处理）。
items.criterion_en: Conditional: any count given for burnovers before 10:00 (or 'in the morning') on Nov 8 must be 11 (9 Cat 1 + 2 Cat 2, Table 30), or shown alongside the text's 'nine (7/2)' with the discrepancy flagged; 'nine' alone fails; giving no such count does not fail (incomplete morning lists are handled under M04).
items.verify: answer-key H03 (TN 2252 p.123/PDF 161 text; Table 30 PDF 163).

items.criterion_zh: 高紧迫度 TRA 平民数：261 为不重复个人，352 为人×暴露次数（表 39）；若加总各 TRA 最小值，须标为人次，不得称为人数。
items.criterion_en: High-urgency TRA civilians: 261 unique individuals vs 352 person-exposures (Table 39); any sum of per-TRA minima must be labelled person-exposures, not people.
items.verify: answer-key H04 (TN 2252 p.158/PDF 196).

items.criterion_zh: 区分 8 个高紧迫度 TRA 与其中 6 个高峰值危险 TRA；不得据 TF-TRA 7 措辞称“8 个 TRA 经历高峰值危险”。
items.criterion_en: Distinguishes 8 high-urgency TRAs from the 6 with high peak hazard; does not state, following TF-TRA 7's wording, that 8 TRAs had high peak hazard.
items.verify: answer-key H05 (TN 2252 p.xxxiii/PDF 35 vs p.137/PDF 175, p.158/PDF 196, Table 31).

items.criterion_zh: 08:01 预警时已着火的分区为 Zone 6（表 11：07:57），而非正文 p.61 所称 Zone 4（表 11：08:41）；图表数据与任何相关陈述均按表或明示差异。
items.criterion_en: The zone already burning at the 08:01 warning is Zone 6 (Table 11: 07:57), not Zone 4 as the text on p.61 says (Table 11: 08:41); chart data and any statement follow the table or flag the discrepancy.
items.verify: answer-key H06 (TN 2252 p.56/PDF 94 vs p.61/PDF 99).

items.criterion_zh: 条件项：若简报给出 Concow 消防员/一线人员首次直接见火时刻，须呈现 TN 2252 内部差异（p.60/PDF 98 写 07:32，p.63/PDF 101 写 07:20，p.57/PDF 95 写 07:20–07:30 之间），或用 07:20 并引 TN 2252 p.63 或 TN 2135（p.59/PDF 89：07:20 经 Rim Road 的消防车遭遇迅速扩大的飞火；p.122/PDF 152）；悄悄用 07:32 判否。未给出该时刻视为通过。
items.criterion_en: Conditional: if the deck gives the time of the first direct firefighter/first-responder observation of fire in Concow, it presents TN 2252's internal discrepancy (07:32 p.60/PDF 98 vs 07:20 p.63/PDF 101; 'between 07:20 and 07:30' p.57/PDF 95) or uses 07:20 citing TN 2252 p.63 or TN 2135 (p.59/PDF 89: engines on Rim Road at 07:20 met rapidly growing spot fires; p.122/PDF 152); a silent 07:32 fails. Giving no such time passes.
items.verify: answer-key H07; TN 2135 p.59/PDF 89 and p.122/PDF 152.

items.criterion_zh: Zones 3/8 定量对齐：疏散令请求 07:46 比首个火数据点（07:50/07:49）早 3–4 分钟，但 CodeRED 07:57 比首火晚 7–8 分钟；需在页面/图表上呈现。
items.criterion_en: Zones 3/8 quantified: the order request at 07:46 preceded first fire data (07:50/07:49) by 3–4 min, but CodeRED at 07:57 came 7–8 min after first fire; shown on slide/chart.
items.verify: answer-key H08; values in calculations.xlsx with formulas.

items.criterion_zh: (a) 更早疏散令的边界：引用表 30 中主干道 burnover 在火到前已拥堵/受阻（#4、6、7、8、22 中 ≥3 个）及 TN 2252 p.59“延迟通知的影响超出研究范围且难以量化”；不声称更早下令可避免 burnover 或死亡，不给出“可挽救人数”。
items.criterion_en: (a) Earlier-orders boundary: cites Table 30's gridlock/obstruction before fire arrival on artery burnovers (≥3 of #4, 6, 7, 8, 22) and TN 2252 p.59 ('impact of delayed notifications ... beyond the scope ... difficult to quantify'); makes no claim that earlier orders would have prevented burnovers or deaths and gives no lives-saved figure.
items.verify: answer-key H09.

items.criterion_zh: (b) 通行能力边界：至少使用表 5 或表 6 的一个 OHU/车道值（如 Zones 3/8/14 为 316，Paradise 以南 2950 或 2529）并注页码，且指出表 4–6 未计入火/障碍造成的车道损失（p.32/PDF 70）；不得把 OHU 比值当作实际通行量或“多一条车道即可救人”的证据。
items.criterion_en: (b) Capacity boundary: uses at least one OHU/egress-lane value from Tables 5 or 6 (e.g. 316 for Zones 3/8/14, 2950 or 2529 south of Paradise) with page, and states that Tables 4-6 exclude lane losses caused by fire or obstructions (p.32/PDF 70); presents no OHU ratio as achieved throughput or as proof that more lanes would have saved lives.
items.verify: answer-key H10 (TN 2252 p.32–33/PDF 70–71).

items.criterion_zh: (c) 燃料处理边界引自 TN 2135：初始高火星通量区深入 Paradise 1 km、显著飞火达 3.4 km，需数百米宽的处理带且环境/财务影响巨大、效果评估超出范围；不声称周边燃料带可阻止 Paradise 起火。
items.criterion_en: (c) Fuel-treatment boundary drawn from TN 2135: initial high ember-flux zone reached 1 km into Paradise, significant spot fires to 3.4 km; treatment hundreds of metres wide with major environmental/financial impacts; effectiveness analysis beyond scope; no claim that a perimeter treatment would have prevented ignition in Paradise.
items.verify: answer-key H11 (TN 2135 p.140/PDF 170; p.136/PDF 166).

items.criterion_zh: 首次观察时刻标注：#5 Windermere、#20 Camelot（及若出现的 #14）的时刻为首次观察、burnover 条件更早已存在；相关间隔标为界限值而非精确值。
items.criterion_en: First-observation flags: times for #5 Windermere and #20 Camelot (and #14 if shown) are first observations with burnover conditions existing earlier; intervals derived from them are labelled as bounds, not exact.
items.verify: answer-key H12 (Table 30 footnote e; Table 12 footnote a).

items.criterion_zh: （仅供人工复核，不计分）地图标注落在报告地图（TN 2252 图 24 / TN 2135 图 47 或所用图）对应道路/地点上。
items.criterion_en: (informational, human review only; not scored) Map annotations sit on the corresponding road/location of the report map (TN 2252 Fig. 24 / TN 2135 Fig. 47 or the map used).
items.verify: Not graded automatically (the judge has neither the source maps nor legible renders).
items.weight_note: v2026-10-25: informational (weight 0, never judged); former weight 2.5 redistributed within tier gate

items.criterion_zh: 火势时程跨报告对齐：“火有多快”一节引用 TN 2135（如 08:30 主火线抵达 Paradise，Apple View Way–Merrill Rd 约 1 km；约 70 分钟后 2.8 km 正面；08:00 前 Pentz Rd 以东飞火）且与 TN 2252 表 11 首火数据点（Zone 8 07:49、Zone 3 07:50）一致、无矛盾。
items.criterion_en: Fire-timing aligned across reports: the 'how fast' section cites TN 2135 (e.g., main front reached Paradise ~08:30 over ~1 km Apple View Way–Merrill Rd; ~70 min later a 2.8 km front; spot fires east of Pentz Rd shortly before 08:00) and is consistent with TN 2252 Table 11 first fire data (Zone 8 07:49, Zone 3 07:50).
items.verify: answer-key H14 (TN 2135 p.122/PDF 152; TN 2252 p.56).
